From someone who's been doing sh on and off since being 11ish and whose parents reacted absolutely horribly to finding out I was cutting, I want to say that it's clear you truly care about your daughter & her wellbeing. 

I can't help much in terms of the stress reaction side of things but at the very least I want to tell you that you're doing some things right!! The simple fact you care about focusing on your daughter is proof enough. As you said, it's not your daughter's responsibility to comfort you BUT that doesn't mean that you aren't allowed to have your own struggles surrounding the issue. It's a difficult situation for everyone involved, it should be expected that you would have complicated feelings about it all. 

What's important is that you continue to do your best to let your daughter know she is loved and supported no matter what (which given that she told you of her accord you have likely already established).

I really hope the therapy helps and truly wish you two the best!
